tools.name: easystore_get_store
tools.description: The store behind this access token: name, contact emails, easystore domain, plan, locale, country, time zone, currencies and locations. Needs no API access scope. GET /api/3.0/store.json.

tools.name: easystore_list_locations
tools.description: The store's stock and pickup locations (warehouses, outlets) with address, phone, is_primary and pickup settings. Use the ids for inventory levels. Needs read_locations. GET /api/3.0/locations.json.

tools.name: easystore_list_products
tools.description: List products with variants, prices, SKUs, stock, images and collections. Filter by collection, SKU, published status or dates. Needs read_products. GET /api/3.0/products.json.

tools.name: easystore_get_product
tools.description: One product by id with its variants, options, images and collections. Needs read_products. GET /api/3.0/products/{id}.json.

tools.name: easystore_list_product_variants
tools.description: The variants of one product (price, SKU, barcode, stock, weight, enabled flag). Needs read_products. GET /api/3.0/products/{id}/variants.json.

tools.name: easystore_list_collections
tools.description: List product collections. Needs read_products. GET /api/3.0/collections.json.

tools.name: easystore_get_collection
tools.description: One collection by id. Needs read_products. GET /api/3.0/collections/{id}.json.

tools.name: easystore_list_inventory_levels
tools.description: Stock per variant per location: available (inventory_quantity), committed, incoming and reserved. Pass variant_ids or location_ids (at least one is required). Needs read_products. GET /api/4.0/inventory_levels.json.

tools.name: easystore_list_orders
tools.description: List orders from every sales channel with customer, items, totals, payment and fulfillment status. Filter by payment or fulfillment status, customer, or dates (store time zone). Needs read_orders. GET /api/3.0/orders.json.

tools.name: easystore_get_order
tools.description: One order by id. Ask for extra sections with fields: items, addresses, transactions, fulfillments, refunds, taxes, customer, shipping_fees, discounts, points, cancellation, note_attributes. Needs read_orders. GET /api/3.0/orders/{id}.json.

tools.name: easystore_list_order_fulfillments
tools.description: The fulfillments (shipments with tracking details and status) of one order. Needs read_fulfillments. GET /api/3.0/orders/{id}/fulfillments.json.

tools.name: easystore_list_order_transactions
tools.description: The payment transactions of one order (gateway, amount, status). Needs read_orders. GET /api/3.0/orders/{id}/transactions.json.

tools.name: easystore_list_checkouts
tools.description: List checkouts (carts in progress or abandoned). Cart tokens are not returned. Needs read_orders. GET /api/3.0/checkouts.json.

tools.name: easystore_list_customers
tools.description: List customers with contact details, order count, total spent, groups and store credit. Search by name or email with query. Needs read_customers. GET /api/3.0/customers.json.

tools.name: easystore_search_customers
tools.description: Find customers by exact email, phone number or customer code. Pass at least one. Needs read_customers. GET /api/3.0/customers/search.json.

tools.name: easystore_get_customer
tools.description: One customer by id. Add fields=points,membership for loyalty data. Needs read_customers. GET /api/3.0/customers/{id}.json.

tools.name: easystore_list_customer_addresses
tools.description: The saved addresses of one customer. Needs read_customers. GET /api/3.0/customers/{id}/addresses.json.

tools.name: easystore_get_customer_points
tools.description: The loyalty points balance of one customer. Needs read_customers. GET /api/3.0/customers/{id}/points.json.

tools.name: easystore_list_customer_groups
tools.description: List customer groups (for example VIP). Needs read_customers. GET /api/3.0/groups.json.

tools.name: easystore_list_pages
tools.description: List the store's content pages. Needs read_content. GET /api/3.0/pages.json.

tools.name: easystore_list_blogs
tools.description: List the store's blogs. Needs read_content. GET /api/3.0/blogs.json.

tools.name: easystore_list_articles
tools.description: List blog articles. Needs read_content. GET /api/3.0/articles.json.

tools.name: easystore_set_inventory_level
tools.description: WRITE. Set the stock of one variant at one location to an exact number (quantity 0 or more). Omit location_id for the primary location. Overwrites the current quantity; use easystore_adjust_inventory_level for a relative change. Needs write_products. PUT /api/4.0/inventory_levels/set.json.

tools.name: easystore_adjust_inventory_level
tools.description: WRITE. Add to or remove from the stock of one variant at one location by a relative amount (positive adds, negative removes; 0 is rejected). Not idempotent: repeating it changes the stock again. Omit location_id for the primary location. Needs write_products. PUT /api/4.0/inventory_levels/adjust.jso

tools.name: easystore_update_variant
tools.description: WRITE. Change one variant's price, compare-at price, cost price, SKU, barcode or enabled flag. Only the fields you pass change. To change stock use the inventory tools. Needs write_products. PUT /api/3.0/products/{product_id}/variants.json.

tools.name: easystore_cancel_order
tools.description: WRITE, hard to undo. Cancel an order, with an optional reason. Confirm the order id and number with the user first. Needs write_orders. POST /api/3.0/orders/{id}/cancel.json.

tools.name: easystore_create_fulfillment
tools.description: WRITE. Mark an order (or some of its line items) as shipped, with tracking details. Not idempotent: calling it twice creates two fulfillments. With notify_customer true the customer is emailed. Needs write_fulfillments. POST /api/3.0/orders/{id}/fulfillments.json.

tools.name: easystore_create_customer
tools.description: WRITE. Create a customer. Pass at least one of first_name, last_name, email or phone. Not idempotent. Needs write_customers. POST /api/3.0/customers.json.

tools.name: easystore_update_customer
tools.description: WRITE. Change fields of an existing customer; only the fields you pass change. Needs write_customers. PUT /api/3.0/customers/{id}.json.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "easystore_search_customers" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: easystore_get_store, easystore_list_customers, easystore_search_customers · Private data: easystore_get_store, easystore_list_checkouts, easystore_list_customers · Public sink: easystore_list_customers, easystore_search_customers, easystore_cancel_order, easystore_create_fulfillment, easystore_create_customer · Destructive: easystore_adjust_inventory_level.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: easystore_get_store, easystore_list_customers, easystore_search_customers · Private data: easystore_get_store, easystore_list_checkouts, easystore_list_customers · Public sink: easystore_list_customers, easystore_search_customers, easystore_cancel_order, easystore_create_fulfillment, easystore_create_customer · Destructive: easystore_adjust_inventory_level

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
